request.system: Determine whether the proposed hypothesis or expression explicitly avoids a failure described in the report. Return JSON only: {"avoids_failure": true|false|null}. Use null when the evidence is unclear. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary; the value must be a JSON boolean or null, never a quoted string.
